responsibility: This file coordinates the overall multi-pass compilation process of the mc front end. It initializes parsing for a source module, probes module kind and source names, opens definition or implementation/program files through mcSearch and mcLexBuf with optional preprocessing, runs passes mcp1 through mcp5 in the required order across the main module and imported definition modules, manages the current pass number, and flushes warnings and errors after each stage, making it the driver that orchestrates front-end analysis rather than performing any single parsing pass itself.
same_name_distinction: Implements the compilation-driver interface declared in GmcComp.h by orchestrating parser initialization, source opening, pass sequencing across main and imported modules, current-pass tracking, and warning/error flushing. Unlike the header, it contains the multi-pass coordination logic and file-opening strategy.
